definition: Rules, agreements and standards that govern how data may be exchanged and reused across systems, institutions or sectors: interoperability frameworks, data-sharing agreements, consent and authorisation controls, audit requirements, open standards and cross-agency arrangements for sharing data. Does not include building, buying or running the systems themselves: data exchange platforms and hubs, APIs and gateways, interoperability or integration layers and software, shared registries, common identifiers and shared data models. Also excludes static publication with no exchange or reuse mechanism, network connectivity alone, and informal coordination with no governance mechanism for sharing data.
